subject: AWS Marketplace listing — provisioning paths and co-sell elevator
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya@orionanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — provisioning paths and co-sell elevator

Kim / Rafael,

Attached is a working draft of the AWS Marketplace product page for the Orion Analytics offer and a short list of provisioning flows (AMI, SaaS via private offer, and BYO-model). Maya looped us in on procurement requirements.

High-level asks:
- Can Product sign off on the hero blurb and trial entitlement language?
- Ops: confirm the recommended provisioning paths are accurate and whether we should default to Private Offer for first wave.
- Sales/Partner: I want a one-paragraph co-sell elevator we can give to AWS field (short, value + ROI + ask).

Attachments: redwood-aws-listing-draft-v2.docx, pricing-matrix-orion.csv

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Chen <maya@orionanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — provisioning paths and co-sell elevator

Thanks Hannah — looks good. Quick notes from procurement side:
- We need a clear trial activation path that doesn't require an initial POC contract signature (they prefer Private Offer trial link with auto-entitlement).
- SOC2 evidence will be required for our security team before Marketplace listing goes live. I attached the evidence package.
- Do you have a DocuSign template for the Private Offer terms? If not, our legal can share one.

Maya
Procurement Manager
Orion Analytics
Attachments: orion-soc2-evidence.zip
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya@orionanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — provisioning paths and co-sell elevator

Hannah — quick review below.

Hero blurb: tighten to focus on predictable latency and lower inference cost. Suggest: "Run production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and optimized unit economics across hosted and private deployments." Keeps feature + outcome.

Trial entitlement: agree with Private Offer trial link as default for Orion. Ops concern: Private Offer trials require us to provision entitlement in the seller console; Rafael, can you confirm if we can auto-entitle without manual steps for the first 30 days?

Co-sell elevator (draft): "Orion Analytics + Redwood Inference: Deliver real-time, cost-efficient LLM inference for analytics workloads — reduce inference cost by up to 3x while meeting sub-100ms tail latency. Ask: enable Private Offer trial and field introduction to enterprise customers evaluating observability and data-residency-conscious AI."

I attached a short PR-ready hero line to the doc.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: redwood-aws-listing-draft-v2.docx
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya@orionanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — provisioning paths and co-sell elevator

Thanks — Rafael here.

Short answers:
- Auto-entitlement: yes, we can support auto-entitlement for Private Offer trials for up to 30 days if Orion agrees to the standard trial terms. Implementation: create the Private Offer with a 30-day entitlement and a single-use trial code; we can script the entitlement via seller console API.
- AMI path: for BYO-model customers we recommend AMI + BYO-license only if they need on-prem isolation; otherwise SaaS via Private Offer is lower friction.
- DocuSign: we have a template; I'll share the DocuSign link once legal signs off. For now, use the standard Private Offer terms.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Hannah to finalize hero blurb and co-sell elevator text (Kim provided a strong draft).
2) Rafael to provision Private Offer draft and share entitlement scripting plan (ETA: 3 business days).
3) Orion to confirm SOC2 evidence receipt and provide any additional compliance questions.

I'll start the Private Offer draft later today.

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
